code.description: Code string entered by customers to apply the coupon.

amount.description: The amount of discount provided by the coupon.

date_created.description: Date and time the coupon was created, in the site's local timezone.

date_created_gmt.description: Date and time the coupon was created, in GMT.

date_modified.description: Date and time the coupon was last modified, in the site's local timezone.

date_modified_gmt.description: Date and time the coupon was last modified, in GMT.

discount_type.description: Determines the calculation type for the discount, such as fixed cart or percent.

description.description: Internal or explanatory description of the coupon.

date_expires.description: Expiration date and time for the coupon in the site's local timezone, or null if it does not expire.

date_expires_gmt.description: Expiration date and time for the coupon in GMT, or null if it does not expire.

usage_count.description: Total number of times this coupon has been used.

individual_use.description: Whether the coupon cannot be used in combination with other coupons.

items.description: Unique identifier of an applicable product.

product_ids.description: List of product IDs that the coupon applies to.

items.description: Unique identifier of an excluded product.

excluded_product_ids.description: List of product IDs that cannot be discounted by this coupon.

usage_limit.description: Maximum number of times this coupon can be used overall, or null for unlimited.

usage_limit_per_user.description: Maximum number of times an individual customer can use this coupon, or null for unlimited.

limit_usage_to_x_items.description: Maximum number of qualifying individual items the coupon can be applied to in a single order, or null.

free_shipping.description: Whether the coupon grants free shipping on qualifying orders.

items.description: Unique identifier of an applicable product category.

product_categories.description: List of category IDs that the coupon applies to.

items.description: Unique identifier of an excluded product category.

excluded_product_categories.description: List of category IDs that cannot be discounted by this coupon.

exclude_sale_items.description: Whether the coupon should not apply to items currently on sale.

minimum_amount.description: Minimum subtotal required in the cart for the coupon to become valid.

maximum_amount.description: Maximum cart subtotal allowed when using the coupon.

items.description: An authorized billing email address or wildcard pattern.

email_restrictions.description: List of customer billing email addresses permitted to use this coupon.

items.description: Identifier or email of a user who redeemed the coupon.

used_by.description: List of customer user IDs or email addresses that have redeemed this coupon.

items.description: A metadata entry associated with the coupon.

meta_data.description: List of custom metadata key-value pairs assigned to the coupon.

href.description: Target URL for the current coupon resource.

items.description: Link relation target for the current coupon resource.

self.description: Self-referencing resource links for the coupon.

href.description: Target URL for the coupons collection endpoint.

items.description: Link relation target for the coupons collection.

_links.description: HATEOAS relation links related to the coupon resource.
